# The Market Journal

> Real estate insights from Steven Smith and Team Smith at The Market Real Estate Co. (Baton Rouge, LA; licensed in Louisiana and Alabama).

## Posts

- [What Do October's Home Sales Numbers Mean for Buyers and Sellers?](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/what-october-home-sales-mean-for-buyers-and-sellers/): Existing-home sales fell 5.5% in October while prices held steady and supply grew. Here is what that means for buyers and sellers.
- [How to Choose a Real Estate Team (and What to Look For in Greater Baton Rouge)](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/how-to-choose-a-real-estate-team/): Verified production, real reviews, and a clear plan matter most. Here are the questions to ask, and how we answer them in Greater Baton Rouge.
- [What Should Homeowners Do Before the First Freeze? A Winter Checklist](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/winter-home-checklist-before-first-freeze/): Insulate exposed pipes, test your alarms, service your heating system, and seal air leaks. Here is a practical winter checklist for any home.
- [How AI Search Is Changing the Way People Find a Real Estate Agent](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/ai-search-and-your-next-agent/): More buyers and sellers are asking AI assistants who to call. Here's what that means for consumers and for agents.
- [The 5 Questions Every Seller Asks First](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/what-sellers-ask-first/): What's my home worth, how long will it take, and what do I need to fix? Straight answers to the questions we hear most.
